title: Feature
description: One record of intermediate-data JSONL: a feature's id, its attributes, and its geometry. Must stay in step with the serialized form of `reearth_flow_types::Feature`, which it mirrors for schema generation only.

attributes.description: Open, string-keyed attribute values; untagged JSON, so unconstrained.

Geometry.title: Geometry
Geometry.description: The top-level geometry type: an absent `None`, a geometry in one of the two embedding dimensions, or a heterogeneous, cross-dimensional collection.

oneOf.description: No geometry: a feature carrying attributes but no spatial payload. This is the default — an absent geometry, distinct from an empty collection.
Heterogeneous, cross-dimensional, cross-frame.

Euclidean2DGeometry.title: 2D geometry
Euclidean2DGeometry.description:
2D-embedded geometry. All coordinates are 2D `(x, y)`; some leaves carry a single optional elevation the whole leaf lies at (2.5D).

The heavy aggregate leaves (`Polygon`, the meshes) are boxed so the small, common variants don't inflate the enum — and `Geometry` with them — to the size of the largest leaf. The small tier (`Point`, `LineString`, `Collection`) stays inline.

oneOf.description: Exterior ring + optional holes.
Indexed, variable face valence.
Indexed, fixed 3-index stride (variable width).
`Multi*` collection of 2D geometries; members may differ in coordinate frame.

Point2D.title: Point (2D)
Point2D.description: A single position in 2D space. Used for CityGML `gml:Point` and 2D point features.

frame.title: Coordinate frame
frame.description: Coordinate frame this position is expressed in.

CoordinateFrame.description:
The coordinate frame a geometry leaf is expressed in.

Every coordinate-bearing leaf carries its own `frame: CoordinateFrame`, so an operation reads its source frame from `self` and a collection may hold members in different frames.

oneOf.description: A geographic / projected CRS identified by its EPSG code.
Bare Euclidean space with no geo-referencing.
A 2D plane embedded in 3D, anchored in a base frame.

TangentPlane.title: Tangent plane
TangentPlane.description:
A 2D Euclidean plane embedded in 3D space.

A [`CoordinateFrame::Tangent`] geometry stores in-plane `(x, y)` whose 3D position is `origin + x * u + y * v`. When `base` is a geographic CRS this is the local tangent (ENU) frame at `origin`, with in-plane coordinates in metres.

base.title: Anchor frame
base.description: Frame that `origin`, `u` and `v` are expressed in.

u.title: In-plane axis U
u.description: Orthonormal in-plane axis; the plane normal is the cross product of `u` and `v`.

BaseFrame.description: The absolute frame a [`TangentPlane`] is anchored in: exactly the non-tangent [`CoordinateFrame`] frames, so a tangent plane cannot be anchored in another tangent plane.

oneOf.description: A geographic / projected CRS identified by its EPSG code.
Bare Euclidean space with no geo-referencing.

LineString2D.title: Polyline (2D)
LineString2D.description: A polyline in 2D space, lying at a single optional elevation (2.5D).

frame.title: Coordinate frame
frame.description: Coordinate frame these coords are expressed in.

z.title: Elevation
z.description: The one elevation the whole chain lies at. `None` = pure 2D.

Polygon2D.title: Polygon (2D)
Polygon2D.description: A planar polygon face in 2D space: an exterior ring plus any interior rings (holes), lying at a single optional elevation.

Appearance.description: Materials, themes, per-face material bindings and per-theme UV for one surface geometry.

materials.title: Material palette
materials.description: Material palette; the bindings in `themes` index into it by position.

themes.title: Themes
themes.description: One independent binding per theme; never empty.

default_theme.title: Default theme
default_theme.description: Which of `themes` a single-theme consumer (glTF / OBJ / CZML / 3D Tiles) should render.

Material.title: Material
Material.description: One self-contained shading description: exactly one of the two shading models.

oneOf.description: CityGML X3DMaterial, OBJ illumination models 1-2.
glTF / 3D Tiles metallic-roughness.

Texture.description: An image plus its sampling parameters, layered over a shared [`Raster`].

uv_channel.title: UV channel
uv_channel.description: Which UV set within the resolved theme this map samples; 0 in the common case.

Raster.description: A shared image. Cheap to clone (`Arc<Raster>`); an edit emits a new feature carrying a new `Arc<Raster>`.

oneOf.description: Owned, encoded image bytes, produced by a texture-editing action or a resolved URI.
The image's own location (its source / identity); loaded lazily, owns no pixels. The scheme-aware `Uri` is one type across file / ram / gcs / http backends.

RasterData.title: Raster data
RasterData.description: Owned, encoded image payload: the original bytes plus their image format.

Sampler.description: How texture coordinates are wrapped and filtered.

WrapMode.description: Texture-coordinate wrap behaviour. The union of CityGML `wrapMode` (none / wrap / mirror / clamp / border) and glTF sampler wrap.

TextureTransform.description: An affine transform applied to texture coordinates before sampling.

ChannelId.description: A material-local UV channel index. Carries no cross-theme meaning: channel 0 under one theme and channel 0 under another are different UV sets.

AlphaMode.description: How a material's alpha channel is interpreted.

ThemeBinding.title: Theme binding
ThemeBinding.description: One theme's face-to-material binding plus the UV sets that theme's textured materials sample.

theme.title: Theme name
theme.description: This theme's name, unique within the appearance.

uv_sets.title: UV sets
uv_sets.description: This theme's UV pool: one entry per `(side, channel)` its materials reference.

ThemeId.description: A dataset-global, stable theme name. Switching to a theme selects the same theme across every feature, so this is an identity (a name), not a per-mesh index (contrast [`ChannelId`]).

FaceBinding.title: Face-to-material index binding
FaceBinding.description: How a theme's faces map to the material palette.

oneOf.description: One material for every face; the common case, and the only form a single-material theme or a `Polygon` ever needs. Indexes the material palette.
Per-face material index; length == face count; `None` = unbound (bare face). `Option<MaterialIndex>` is 4 bytes per face (see [`MaterialIndex`]).

MaterialIndex.title: Material index
MaterialIndex.description: Position of a material in the enclosing appearance's `materials` palette, counting from zero.

UvSet.title: UV set
UvSet.description: One UV set, owned by the theme it belongs to. A map finds its set by matching both `side` and `channel`.

channel.title: UV channel
channel.description: Material-local UV channel these coordinates serve, matched against a texture's `uv_channel`.

Side.description: Which side of an oriented surface an appearance applies to. The front side faces along the surface normal (from its winding). Side is a simultaneous axis (both sides exist at once), distinct from a theme (mutually-exclusive styling variants).

UvSource.description: Wire form of [`UvSource`]; see it for the UV coordinate convention.

oneOf.description: Per-corner coordinates, nested to mirror the host geometry's faces and rings.
A 3x4 world-to-texture projective matrix, applying to the whole surface.

FaceUv.title: Per-face UV
FaceUv.description:
UV coordinates for one host face, nested to mirror that face's rings.

The enclosing array runs parallel to the host's own face list: one entry for a polygon, one per member of `faces`, or one per member of `triangles`.

exterior.title: Exterior ring UV
exterior.description: UV for the face's exterior ring, one pair per corner.

holes.title: Hole ring UV
holes.description: UV for each hole ring, in the host's hole order, one pair per corner.

TexMatrix.title: World-to-texture matrix
TexMatrix.description: A 3x4 world-to-texture projective matrix. Maps a homogeneous world position `(x, y, z, 1)` to `(s', t', q')`, with the texture coordinate recovered as `(s, t) = (s'/q', t'/q')`.

PolygonMesh2D.title: Polygon mesh (2D)
PolygonMesh2D.description: A connected, vertex-sharing polygon mesh in 2D space, lying at a single optional elevation. Each face carries its rings as coordinates.

Face2D.title: Face (2D)
Face2D.description: One mesh face in 2D: an exterior ring of coordinates and any hole rings.

TriangularMesh2D.title: Triangle mesh (2D)
TriangularMesh2D.description: A triangle mesh in 2D space, lying at a single optional elevation. Each triangle carries its three corners as coordinates.

Collection2D.title: 2D collection
Collection2D.description: A `Multi*` collection of 2D geometries; members may differ in coordinate frame.

attrs.title: Per-member attributes
attrs.description: Per-member attributes, parallel to `members`; empty = no member carries any. Child-scoped.

Euclidean3DGeometry.title: 3D geometry
Euclidean3DGeometry.description:
3D-embedded geometry. All coordinates are 3D `(x, y, z)`.

The heavy aggregate leaves (`PointCloud`, `Polygon`, the meshes, `Solid`) are boxed so the small, common variants don't inflate the enum — and `Geometry` with them — to the size of the largest leaf. The small tier (`Point`, `LineString`, `Csg`, `Collection`) stays inline; `Csg` already boxes its own operands.

oneOf.description: Face in 3D space.
Indexed, variable face valence.
Indexed, fixed 3-index stride (variable width).
Exterior + interior shells as coordless raw meshes; one frame on the Solid.
Coordless boolean tree; frames come from its operand Solids.
`Multi*` collection of 3D geometries; members may differ in coordinate frame.

Point3D.title: Point (3D)
Point3D.description: A single position in 3D space. Used for CityGML `gml:Point`, OBJ vertices, and 3D point features.

frame.title: Coordinate frame
frame.description: Coordinate frame this position is expressed in.

PointCloud.title: Point cloud
PointCloud.description: A 3D point cloud: one or more acquisition segments sharing a coordinate frame.

Segment.title: Acquisition segment
Segment.description: One acquisition source's points: their positions in the encoding they are stored in, plus any per-point attribute columns.

Positions.description: Per-point positions in their stored encoding.

AttributeColumn.description: Typed column for user-defined per-point attributes (LAS Extra Bytes, PDAL extra dims, etc.). Schema-based: every column has exactly `Segment::count` entries. SoA layout: one `Vec<T>` per attribute, accessed one column at a time.

oneOf.description: `None` = null / not yet assigned.

frame.title: Coordinate frame
frame.description: Coordinate frame these coords are expressed in.

Polygon3D.title: Polygon (3D)
Polygon3D.description: A planar polygon face in 3D space: an exterior ring plus any interior rings (holes).

PolygonMesh3D.title: Polygon mesh (3D)
PolygonMesh3D.description: A connected, vertex-sharing polygon mesh in 3D space. Each face carries its rings as coordinates, written alongside the frame rather than nested under the frameless mesh data a solid's shell shares.

Face3D.title: Face (3D)
Face3D.description: One mesh face in 3D: an exterior ring of coordinates and any hole rings.

TriangularMesh3D.title: Triangle mesh (3D)
TriangularMesh3D.description: A triangle mesh in 3D space. Each triangle carries its three corners as coordinates, written alongside the frame rather than nested under the frameless mesh data a solid's shell shares.

Solid.title: Solid
Solid.description: A volumetric solid bounded by an exterior shell and any number of interior (void) shells. Appearance lives on each shell's mesh.

frame.title: Coordinate frame
frame.description: Coordinate frame this solid's shells are expressed in; the shells themselves are coordless raw meshes.

Shell.title: Boundary shell
Shell.description: One closed boundary of a [`Solid`]: a general polygon mesh or a triangle mesh, stored as coordinate-free mesh data so the boundary cannot carry a frame of its own — its frame is the `Solid`'s.

PolygonMesh3DData.title: Shell polygon mesh (3D)
PolygonMesh3DData.description: The faces of a 3D polygon mesh, with no coordinate frame of their own: a solid's shell stores this form and takes the frame from the solid.

TriangularMesh3DData.title: Shell triangle mesh (3D)
TriangularMesh3DData.description: The triangles of a 3D triangle mesh, with no coordinate frame of their own: a solid's shell stores this form and takes the frame from the solid.

Csg.title: Boolean combination
Csg.description: A boolean combination of two volumetric operands.

ThreeDimensional.title: Volumetric operand
ThreeDimensional.description: Volumetric, closed 3D geometries that `Csg` boolean operations are defined over.

oneOf.description: Boxed: a `Solid` (with its shells' appearance) is far larger than the boxed `Csg`, so the leaf is boxed to keep the enum small.

Collection3D.title: 3D collection
Collection3D.description: A `Multi*` collection of 3D geometries; members may differ in coordinate frame.

attrs.title: Per-member attributes
attrs.description: Per-member attributes, parallel to `members`; empty = no member carries any. Child-scoped.

GeometryCollection.title: Geometry collection
GeometryCollection.description: Ordered members, each optionally carrying its own attributes.

attrs.title: Per-member attributes
attrs.description: Per-member attributes parallel to `members`; empty = no member carries any. Child-scoped: not exposed as the feature's own attributes.
